oraclePolicy: The tool return value is never its own correctness evidence. Channels read: durable guard-consult facts, confined-spawn counters, on-disk markers, World transcript/ledger, mock connection counters, /proc tripwire, host-pid liveness. tests/world-factory/lib/oracle.mjs was not directly wired (see README section 7.6).
scopeDefinition: governed preset a5sf-governed-member with alpha6ReviewRouting true (A6 on)

cases.decisive: PASS A6-2 wakes=3 notifications=0 requests=17 (r1) / requests=16 (r1b); PASS A6-4 file=c1-a6-allow-*.txt; PASS A6-5 leaderWakes=0
cases.oracle: durable request/decision + on-disk effect file + wake transcript
cases.falsifier: Leader woken, no file, no decision

cases.decisive: PASS A6-6 requests=2 decisions=2 consumptions=2 pending=; PASS A6-27 executed=true outcome=succeeded facts=1

FAIL A6-28 request=none decision=none consumed=false execFacts=0 file=false done=true (both boots); a6-exec-negatives.json deny.request=null; tool result "permission denied: exec fingerprint ... answered deny from the fallback"
cases.oracle: control ledger: no control-request-recorded row for the deny prompt; the base permission fallback answered before the A6 plane
cases.falsifier: a durable control-request-recorded row would be needed before a deny verdict is meaningful
cases.note: measurement-precondition failure, not proof that a human deny of a durable request fails

cases.decisive: FAIL A6-29 request=none consumed=false execFacts=none callId=none done=true (both boots); same fallback deny
cases.falsifier: a consumed request with a succeeded fact

cases.decisive: pd33 three-automatic-rounds rounds=3; terminal-complete finalPhase=complete; complete-call-accepted call=true (A5 governed, A6 off); A6-27 outcome=succeeded facts=1 (A6-on attribution leg)
cases.oracle: goal-phase transcript (rounds/finalPhase) + create_goal result; A6-27 execution fact
cases.falsifier: a refused create_goal under the A6-on composition or a goal never reaching complete
cases.note: no shipped instrument composes A6-on with governed create_goal; the RuntimeRoot ^ SourceKindUser rule is evidenced in two halves, not jointly

cases.decisive: r1 FAIL A6-12 lateStatus=200 lateDecision={decision:allow} consumed=true file=""; r2 PASS A6-12 consumed=false file=""
cases.oracle: late-allow decision + consumption ledger + effect file
cases.falsifier: a consumption entry for a post-Stop allow is the failing observation
cases.note: race in the Stop-vs-consumption window; not averaged

cases.decisive: both boots FAIL A6-22 cancel=true markers= wakeRows= wakes=1->1; FAIL A6-23 restart=ok markers=; FAIL A6-24 markers=; a6-sticky-stop.json rows=[] stoppedRows=[] wakeRows=[] markersAfterRestart=[]
cases.oracle: marker file existence + wake rows + wake counter + restart
cases.falsifier: a stopped-*.json marker would flip this; none exists
cases.note: consistent with RELEASE-NOTES-0.1.6 section 4.7 latch-scoped marker limit; recorded as reproduced limit, not a new defect

cases.decisive: PASS A6-13 exited=true restart=ok decision=null consumed=false file=false; PASS A6-14 abandon=invocation-abandoned consumed=false file=false
cases.oracle: host-pid liveness across SIGKILL/restart + durable request row + absence of consumption/effect
cases.falsifier: execution before restart or a deny rewrite

cases.decisive: both boots pendingBefore=1 pendingAfter=0 discoverable=true pendingCount=0 abandoned=1 recoveryCode=CONTROL_REQUEST_ABANDONED restart=ok verdict=abandoned-terminal; a6-inbox-unclaimed.json abandonedAfter=[control-request-abandoned:invocation-abandoned]
cases.oracle: abandonment fact + public remote discovery of the request id + wake counters
cases.note: D11 / release-notes section 5 known path; kit check FAIL is by design because its ok predicate excludes abandoned-terminal

notes: Ten single-boot kit runs (two per arm), all at the frozen SHA and host pin. Allow path, single consumption/execution and SIGKILL cold recovery pass in both boots. Deny/throw arms never reach a durable request (base permission fallback), Sticky Stop writes no durable marker (documented 4.7 limit), A6-26 reproduces the documented abandonment, and Stop-vs-consumption disagrees between boots.
